Variant 1

Stats

LOW_HouseOfGrief_Cultist_Sentry_Halfling
Sharran Sentries are followers of Shar tasked with guarding her cloisters.

Involvement

Three Sharran sentries are in the Cloister of Sombre Embrace.

Combat

Sharran sentries are basic, low-level fighters who cannot use any actions beside the standard set of  Dash,  Jump, and  Main Hand Attack. However, they can still be dangerous due to their passive  Shadow Ambush combined with Sharran Fidelians casting  Darkness on the party.

Attacks and actions

Known Sharran sentries

  •  Sharran Sentry Baxta
  •  Sharran Sentry Hendly
  •  Sharran Sentry Imwise

There is also  Sentry Fredrichk, though he has different stats and abilities compared to other sentries.

Related quests

  • ⁠Daughter of Darkness
  • ⁠Investigate the House of Grief

Notes

Visually, Sharran sentries appear to be wearing  Chain Shirt, though they are actually equipped with Ring Mail Armour.
